priorityList: Use Power Infusion, Blood Fury, and Berserking when Summon Demonic Tyrant is active.
Use on-use Trinkets, ideally synchronized with Summon Demonic Tyrant.
Cast Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer stacks of Demonic Core.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan if the Dominion of Argus buff is active.
Cast Grimoire: Imp Lord and Grimoire: Fel Ravager on cooldown.
Cast Summon Demonic Tyrant on cooldown.
Cast Implosion if you have at least 6 Wild Imps and the To Hell and Back talent is active.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan whenever you have 3 or more Soul Shards.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Demonbolt to apply or refresh Doom if it is not active and you have a Demonic Core stack.
Cast Demonbolt if you have Demonic Core stacks and fewer than 4 Soul Shards.
Cast Shadow Bolt as a filler to generate Soul Shards when no other actions are available.
